rationale: The badge shows '-50%', which the adjacent text 'on all seeds this week' does not state, yet alt is empty so the discount is lost to screen reader users.
A thin grey horizontal line used as a divider; it carries no information, so hiding it loses nothing.
The alt text is a file name, 'IMG_2041.jpg', which says nothing about the product shown.
The alt 'Canvas garden bag with two leather handles' describes the product image that matches the 'Garden bag' item it illustrates.
'Demo Shop' is the site name in the header followed by navigation links, not a title for the text after it.
'Delivery' is a bold paragraph that titles the delivery paragraph after it but is not marked up as a heading.
The title 'Page' is generic and does not say the page is about garden tools.
'Learn more' sits alone in its paragraph; neither the link text nor its surrounding context says where it leads.
The postcode field has no visible label; only the title tooltip says what to enter, and the following element is another field, not a button.
Once filled in, the placeholder 'Name' disappears and no visible label remains; the 'Check delivery' button does not say what to enter.
'Demo Shop' is the site name in the header bar before the navigation, not a section title for following text.
The title 'Offers - Demo Shop' matches the page's main heading 'Offers' and names the site.
The Account menu, the Fern tile and the Cactus button respond to the mouse but cannot take keyboard focus.
The Account menu span has a click handler but cannot take focus, and no other stop in the walk offers an account control.
The Cactus tile has role button but never takes keyboard focus.
Focus starts on 'Seeds and bulbs: all offers' near the bottom of main, then jumps to the header navigation and back up into main, which does not follow reading order.
At stop 2 (Home) nothing changes on focus (changesOnFocus is empty), so focus is invisible.

At stop 4 (Cart) nothing changes on focus, so focus is invisible.
At stop 5 (Help) the background, text colour and underline change on focus, giving a visible indicator.
The Home, Products and Cart links show no change on focus, and two links take focus entirely covered by the sticky header.
Stops 6 and 7 ('Roses, 20% off', 'Tulips, 3 for 2') take focus with coveredShare 1, entirely hidden behind the sticky header.
Stops 6 and 7 are entirely covered (coveredShare 1) by the sticky header while focused, so part of them is certainly hidden.
